fixed_point_key_definition: canonical_name + tab + selection_rank + tab + TerraClimate latitude-grid index + tab + TerraClimate longitude-grid index, canonical-name/selection-rank order

fixed_point_source.guard: The source occurrence sample is capped and QC-filtered and is not a complete census of each geographic range. Dynamic inference therefore concerns the sampled occupied distribution.

fixed_point_selection.algorithm: Within each species, remove the outer 5% of spherical distances from the sample spherical centroid, deduplicate TerraClimate grid cells, then use deterministic spherical maximin traversal starting at the retained cell nearest the centroid.

dynamic_climate.method_guard: Fixed locations are followed through climate time. GBIF occurrence year is not used as the temporal sampling process. Do not interpret TerraClimate-derived long-term trends independently of the parent reanalysis. Do not mix TerraClimate v1.0 and v1.1.

geometry.annual_hypervolume: 95% shrinkage-Gaussian ellipsoid in four globally standardized annual climate dimensions
geometry.turnover: Bhattacharyya overlap loss between consecutive annual Gaussian hypervolumes
geometry.space_time_decomposition: variance among fixed-location means versus mean within-location variance across years in the same standardized annual climate coordinates

model: Existing conditional organization design: documentation propensity weighting, L2 multinomial metric + geographic extent, C-only/S-only/C+S, 499 family bootstraps; pure C/S family-clustered GLM retained as sensitivity with Holm correction.
inference_status: Prospectively specified before the TerraClimate dynamic outcome is observed, but not externally preregistered.
